value.rationale: Conflict removal is a defining motivation of Aligned-MTL. The result identifies exactly when full-rank two-task uniform aggregation remains common descent and when norm imbalance overturns that property. The safe window collapses near antiparallelity, and the equal-norm identity shows that internal orthogonalization can be completely invisible in the actual model update.
